messages:
Maya Ortiz: During today's onboarding lab a user hit a 429 and our Go sample printed a generic error. They couldn't find retry info. Can we align SDK surfaces?

Samir Patel: We should. Current state: Python/JS raise RateLimitError with retry_after. Go returns error{msg}.

Diego Morales: Proposal: HTTP error body includes error_type, status, message, retry_after (opt), and error_id for support. SDKs map error_type -> typed exception.

Lucy Chen: Also standardize copy. E.g. message: 'Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 2s or contact support with error_id.' Avoid internal jargon.

Maya Ortiz: Streaming note: final error frame should use same shape so client libs can surface partial results + final failure.

Samir Patel: I'll add Go mapping in samir/err-parity. Will include unit tests and a migration note for folks parsing raw status codes. PR when ready.

ci-bot: Build queued for samir/err-parity

Samir Patel: CI green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/201

Diego Morales: Docs task: add mapping table and small sample snippets showing catching typed errors and using e.retry_after for backoff. Lucy can you own docs?

Lucy Chen: Yes. I'll update onboarding samples and add copy guidelines. Will include example patterns for JS/Go/Python.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks all. Goal: ship fix & docs before next onboarding session.
